name: Net yield
requirement: 12%+ net APY in USD, sustained at least 1 month

name: All costs in
requirement: Net of gas, slippage, hedging, rebalancing

name: Exitability
requirement: Deployable and exitable within defined windows

name: Native DeFi income
requirement: Fees, funding, lending spreads, leverage carry

name: Exclusions
requirement: No off-chain loans, RWA income, CeFi arbitrage, reinsurance or CLOs, T-bills inside a reserve are fine

name: Market neutral
requirement: No reliance on token price appreciation

name: Attribution
requirement: Every basis point traced to a source

name: Incentives
requirement: Only incentives paid and claimable in the period
